candidates.explanation: The JWT access-token strategy verifies tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret'. Access tokens are signed in AuthService.getTokensData with 'auth.secret', so signature verification always fails and every protected request gets 401. Refresh still works because the refresh strategy and refresh-token signing both use the refresh secret.

fix.description: Use the access-token secret, 'auth.secret', in secretOrKey.
